notes.title: Demo Update 0.6.9
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/bc86ca8dc411fc6d62e7989c2024b9ef06c53c75.png"]

Hi Tavern Keepers!



Thank you very much for the support and the feedback!

Here are the changes for version 0.6.9 :



Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, you may have to start a new game from scratch.


Added
Added 3 more fish types

Added French translations for orders

Added a buff to Chickens when they spend the night in a coop

Added glow on Chicken Eggs and Apples for better visibility
Changed
A new speech bubble will replace an existing one on the Villagers (trying to make Twitch messaging more consistent)

Decreased the area around Tavern doors where player can't place items
Fixed
Fixed an issue where Cows would try to use Chicken Coops at night

Fixed an issue preventing Chickens from producing eggs

Fixed the collider on walls with windows the would not allow placement

Attempt at fixing an issue with Fruit Crusher not having an active item on reload

Attempt at fixing an issue where Inventory is not saved correctly



Remember you can always report bugs, give feedback and talk to me directly on discord!

Join Evergreen Tavern Discord





Take care,

Rom

notes.title: Demo update 0.6.8
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/eaf66cf7f41bbeff47bf35d025840e49fd213753.png"]



Hello Tavern Keepers!



🇫🇷 Oui oui, la Taverne parle aussi français maintenant !* 

🍺And some good news for Twitch streamers who can now add their channel name in the settings and should see their chat talking to them as the villagers 🙂



Here are the changes that came with the new update 0.6.8:

Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, you may have to start a new game from scratch.


Added
Players can now enter a Twitch channel name and the chat will be spoken by the villagers (still working on this)

Added French localization and the ability to switch language from the menu (some translations might be missing)
Fixed
Fixed an issue where pressing Q (A on French layout) would leave Rename UI (dogs/tavern/signposts)



Remember you can always report bugs, give feedback and talk to me directly on discord!

http://discord.nullmoongames.com



Take care,

Rom



* Yes yes, the tavern also speaks French now!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.6.7
notes.notes:
Hello Tavern Keepers!



Here are the changes for this 0.6.7 version:
Changed
Added the ability to keep E pressed in order to keep serving with Refillable Barrels
Fixed
Fixed issue where Fruit Crusher would not be saved

Fixed an issue where gravity was not applied when casting fishing rod

Fixed an issue where Empty Barrels could be refilled infinitely (max is 20)

Fixed an issue where items could be placed in water

Fixed collision in part of the Tavern's roof



I am working on a cool little thing that will be funny for Twitch content creators :)



As usual, feel free to join Discord and come talk to me!

http://discord.nullmoongames.com



Take care,

Rom

notes.title: Update 0.6.4
notes.notes:
Hi Tavern Keepers 🍻🌲,



Thank you so much for all the feedback on Discord so far! This update aims at fixing the following:


Fixes
Fixed an issue where the world space menu would not update when a product was served

Fixed an issue where bought extensions would not be saved

Fixed an ID issue that replaced Fruit Crushers with Refillable Barrels

Fixed an issue where hitting the Esc key to leave Order Menu would also open the pause menu 
Known Issues
It has been reported that the Fishing Rod and the Pond will not stay unlocked at the Merchant after loading a save

Please note that since the Save System has been updated, your current save will probably not be compatible with this new version!



Thank you for playing, I have been so glad to receive all the feedback recently 😊



As always you can reach out to me directly on discord

Evergreen Tavern Discord



Take care,

Rom

notes.title: 0.6.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:

Take care!

Rom

notes.title: Demo update 0.6
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/4f56c946cf95d926586b2beb1999a2b2e22412cf.png"]

Hi Tavern Keepers!



Finally! FISH ARE HERE 🐟 



You can unlock the Fishing Rod from leveling, along with the Pond where you can put your lovely friends. Each of them will count towards your Reputation bonus (up to a certain maximum multiplier)



Here are the changes that came with the new update 0.6:



Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, you may have to start a new game from scratch.


Added
Added Fishing Rod item, which can be bought at the Merchant at level 7

Added Pond item, which can be bought at the Merchant at level 7

Added colliders to water
Changed
Increased villagers' speed further

Disabled Cart item for now

Set max Tavern Level for Demo to 7 instead of 5
Fixed
Fixed a bug where a barrel with 1 serving left will spawn drinks even when empty if the interact button is kept pressed

Fixed a bug where buying a Fruit Crusher would spawn a Refillable Barrel in the Delivery Zone

Fixed an issue where Shield and Sword decoration item would be unlocked twice from leveling


Known issues
Lava in Dungeons is rendering with a pink tint

Cows get stuck after some time and won't move anymore



Happy fishing!



Remember you can always report bugs, give feedback and talk to me on discord!

http://discord.nullmoongames.com



Take care,

Rom

notes.title: Demo update 0.5
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/1b780c9a7470e1fcc961c8e0727cc1b63e4f100b.png"]

Hi Tavern Keepers!



Thank you again to all of you for all the incredible support in the past weeks!



Here are the changes that came with the new update 0.5:



Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, it is advised to start a new game from scratch.


Added
Fences and Crops now snap together when being placed

Added a new item at the Merchant: Chicken Coop. Chickens will go sleep inside a placed Chicken Coop providing there's room (up to 9 chickens per coop)

Drinks will now be poured from barrels as long as the interact key is being pressed

Added one more room variant to Dungeons
Changed
Adjusted chest spawn chances in Dungeons

Improved performance of Dungeons generation

Reorganized tutorial windows layout

Added a way for enemies to travel between Dungeon rooms
Fixed
Fixed instances of an issue where enemies would get stuck and then teleport directly to their desired location

Fixed and adjusted some tutorial information


Known issues
Some enemies might still get stuck or behave erratically

Dungeons still stutter a bit when being generated



The chicken coop is only the beginning... 🐮🐷🐶



Remember you can always report bugs, give feedback and talk to me on discord!

http://discord.nullmoongames.com



Take care,

Rom

notes.title: Demo update 0.4
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45623041/de49a629751e9cc535eac6f28a1b4f52fc9bd5f0.png"]

Hi Tavern Keepers!


First of all, thank you so much!!!!
to everyone who played Evergreen Tavern's demo! It's been so cool seeing y'all play and have fun, getting your feedback and meeting some great people along the way :)



Here are the changes that came with the new update 0.4:



Please note that in order to get the full experience of the new changes, it is advised to start a new game from scratch.


Added
Apple seeds can be planted and will grow into Apple Trees

New item: Fruit Crusher can be bought at the Merchant, use it to crush Apples into juice!

Added a visual list when adding something on the tavern menu with product icons, name and quantities

Added a button to the Cooking Pot interface allowing to display already discovered recipes and automatically fill the Cooking Pot slots with the required ingredients if in inventory

Added the ability to close all menus with the Escape key
Changed
Doubled speed at which the Water Jug adds water to crops

Increased speed at which Player moves when crouched
Fixed
Fixed a game breaking issue where the Player could sometimes not move anymore after being killed 3 times in the dungeons

Fixed an issue where snow and wind could trigger at the end of every day

Fixed incorrect naming on Apple seeds in order menu and pickable item
Known issues
The tutorial windows are sometimes inconsistent, some information is missing and some pictures are incorrect

The enemies in dungeons will sometimes get stuck and directly teleport to their desired destination after some time

The dungeons can sometimes have very little loot in them

Some items are hard to place down with precision (especially the flower pots)



I hope you are looking forward to what's coming next, I'm cooking some cool stuff ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Take care,

Rom
